method: Audit stale whole_character_context field_status against the persisted P4 position_migration_review whole-character record. This review does not re-review source pages; it only determines whether an already-persisted P4 whole-character original-page review can replace obsolete P3 editorial/pending status text.
limits: This is a canonical state synchronization audit, not a new normative source review.
A mapping conflict_fail_closed remains a mapping conflict; synchronization only closes the stale whole_character_context status when the whole-character original-page record is already persisted.
No artwork, PDF, manifest, CI release, or publication state is changed.
